items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: A guy throws a Coca-Cola bottle at Cab and missed him, and hit the drummer.

ctx.x: A guy throws a Coca-Cola bottle at Cab and missed him, and hit the drummer. And the drummer then left Cab and went with us, in Don Redman's band. He said, "I hope it don't happen tonight what happened then." And some of the boys say, "What happened?" He said, "A guy threw a bottle at Cab Calloway and missed him, and hit me." Cab thought he was White. You know, he's light... He thought he was White, and he was talking to some White woman. A fellow asked him to play some number, and he was talking to her, and he…
